import hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path

root = Path('products/distribution/sqlite-curated-tools')
draft = root / 'operator-listing-draft.json'
json.loads(draft.read_bytes())
comparables = []
for number in (37, 43):
    path = root / 'raw' / f'director-pr-{number}-files.json'
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    additions = []
    for entry in json.loads(raw):
        if Path(entry['filename']).name.lower().startswith('readme'):
            additions.extend(line[1:] for line in entry.get('patch', '').splitlines() if line.startswith('+') and not line.startswith('+++'))
    assert additions, f'No README additions found for PR {number}'
    comparables.append({'pull_request': number, 'source': f'https://api.github.com/repos/planetopendata/awesome-sqlite/pulls/{number}/files', 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), 'added_readme_lines': additions})
result = {'draft': str(draft), 'draft_sha256': hashlib.sha256(draft.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'comparables': comparables, 'evidence_limit': 'README additions establish listing precedents within these PRs. Contributor eligibility, AI participation, and acceptance of the bound draft require separate evidence.', 'reconsider_on': 'Applicable maintainer guidance or an explicit maintainer decision covering the disclosed submission.'}
out = root / 'operator-draft-comparable-binding.json'
out.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
assert json.loads(out.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) == result
print(json.dumps({'artifact': str(out), 'draft_sha256': result['draft_sha256'], 'readme_additions_by_pr': {item['pull_request']: len(item['added_readme_lines']) for item in comparables}}))
